seed_data_creation: Frontend-only. Seed pattern: `localStorage.setItem('diagnosis_history', JSON.stringify(<single_json_string_of_array>))` — i.e. the value in localStorage must be the JSON-encoded string of the JSON string of the items array (double-JSON), matching what storage.setItem writes. Prior iteration's double-json via Python f-string produces a SINGLE-encoded value in localStorage and appears empty to readHistory; use `page.evaluate((s)=>{localStorage.setItem('diagnosis_history', JSON.stringify(s));}, JSON.stringify(items))` instead. Two legacy items (no imageInfo, assessmentPossible:false) and one full item (with imageInfo) were used across the three flows. Valid 700x700 JPEG for uploads is at /tmp/valid_seed.jpg (~370KB).
